title: Trump Meets Netanyahu: The Next Massive Strike on Iran Is Coming | Col. Macgregor
summary: A retired US Army colonel claims the US has lost the war with Iran, that the war has become regional, that Russia is winning in Ukraine and poses no real threat to NATO, and that a new Eurasian axis is forming.

assertions.quote: this is a regional war now. Uh this is no longer limited to Israel and Iran and the United States.

verdicts.note: Contemporary reports describe Iraqi militias, the Houthis and Gulf states drawn in, though no great power has joined the fighting.
The paper says the war brought the region 'to the brink of a wider war', with the ceasefire covering allies in all theatres including Lebanon, which is regional spread short of a full regional war.
PRIO describes rising hostility in 2026 among Arab states, Israel and the USA that could escalate into a larger regional war, a risk rather than a confirmed region-wide war.

assertions.quote: the United States armed forces thus far have lost

verdicts.note: Iran's government survived and shipping was disrupted, but US forces were not defeated in the field; the verdict depends on which war aims count.
The campaign produced the opposite of its aims and Iran's closure of Hormuz 'imposed the ceasefire', but both sides claimed victory and Iran was also devastated, so 'lost' overstates it.

assertions.quote: if you look uh at the Russians right now, contrary to what people are saying in the west, they are advancing.

verdicts.note: Russia holds the initiative and gains ground slowly at very high cost, but Ukraine's lines have not collapsed.

assertions.quote: the Russian military is stronger today than at any time since the 1980s

verdicts.note: Russia's army is larger and battle-hardened, with higher arms output, but it has used up much of its Soviet equipment stock and is reconstituting rather than at a peak.
US intelligence says Russia's forces are larger and arguably more capable than in 2022, but makes no comparison with the 1980s.

assertions.quote: they're unsure about this Russian threat, and they should be unsure about it because it's not real as we know

verdicts.note: Forecasters put an overt Russian armed attack on a NATO member within a few years well under even odds, though hybrid incidents are frequent.

assertions.quote: a growing axis that I would say consists of Russia, China, Iran, and I would add Turkey

verdicts.note: Turkey is a NATO member at odds with Iran and Russia in Syria, and the others cooperate loosely without any alliance.

assertions.quote: to drive the American military presence completely out of the region and that's going to happen

verdicts.note: US forces stayed in the Gulf through 2026, with more carrier groups sent in, and no withdrawal has been announced.

assertions.quote: the cost of oil coming off a ship right now is about $140 a barrel
I think it's all going to collapse because we're broke.

verdicts.note: Past oil shocks caused recessions, not collapse, and benchmark prices eased during the war.
